
## Focus Areas for Next Cycle
- Investigate fold14 specifically (appears to be the stress fold driving worst MDD)
- Consider MDD-constrained optimization variants
- Explore ensemble between champion stability and candidate's lockbox-min characteristics

Ready to proceed when you are. 🚀

- and what constraint/selection tweak will most likely move the frontier (e.g., add a hard cap on worst_mdd during selection).
